execution_surface: native parent synthesis of cited independent role execution and/or actual controlled tests
evidence_maturity: observed analysis output; distinguish proposed interventions inside detail
operation: Converted attacks into openings with independent concern roles.
result: Openings include evidence-conditioned action, phase-specific records, complete obligation mapping, rule/ownership changes, and removal of redundant obligations. Hard constraint: do not skip required strategy coverage.

detail.attack: The frozen shape-validation pass does not establish that the methods help choose better interventions.
detail.provenance: Observed coexistence of 16 passes, 16 not_run entries, and effectiveness_tested=false.
detail.exposed_assumption: Shape evidence is treated as if it answered an outcome question.
detail.new_degree_of_freedom: Choose evidence acquisition independently of the available workflow.
detail.test: Run both a direct-inspection condition and incumbent condition on the same bounded decision cases.
detail.retention: Retain evidence boundary now; retain comparative efficacy as unresolved.

detail.attack: A tiny unit that says only propose one different mechanism leaves the decision consumer unable to choose or abstain responsibly.
detail.attacked_claim: Any smaller mechanism description is a faithful reduction.
detail.provenance: Constructed reduction challenge checked against S04 explicit recomposition and hidden-glue constraints.
detail.exposed_assumption: Mechanism description alone is sufficient for an owned decision.
detail.new_degree_of_freedom: Change the unit from proposal to decision with a linked loss ledger.
detail.test: Remove owner, constraint, evidence boundary, or expiry one at a time; see whether another investigator can still derive the intended next action without inventing facts.
detail.retention: Retain repaired decision unit; do not claim the existing catalog caused hidden-glue failure.

detail.attack: Every added critique requires another candidate, so more critique always expands the feasible space.
detail.attacked_claim: Mandatory creativity after every attack improves analysis.
detail.provenance: Attack is contrary to the source lens terminal dispositions, not an observed catalog defect.

evidence.selector: Logical inversion; Attack to expand; Composition with the existing strategies

detail.exposed_assumption: The source is being misread as requiring novelty from every critique.
detail.test: Read the listed invalid-attack and hard-constraint terminal dispositions.
detail.retention: Reject this attack on the actual source; preserve it as a warning against a future misimplementation.

detail.attack: Executing every strategy creates work, so abandon the catalog and finish only the cheapest route.
detail.attacked_claim: Current research may discard explicit coverage to maximize economy.
detail.provenance: Contradicts the current task constraint; S12 itself rejects sacrificing required outcomes.
detail.disposition: hard constraint with no feasible opening
detail.exposed_assumption: Optional adoption and requested research coverage are being conflated.
detail.test: Check whether the action leaves every strategy executed. It would not.
detail.retention: Reject abandonment. Direct exits remain legitimate conclusions inside executed strategies.

detail.attack: Changing who may decide could remove the need to generate further proposals.
detail.attacked_claim: Every delayed choice is an information-generation problem.
detail.provenance: Conjectural operational pattern. The current brief names an owner, but no delay caused by authority is observed.
detail.exposed_assumption: Decision authority is adequate whenever more information is produced.
detail.new_degree_of_freedom: Alter ownership or exception routing rather than analysis throughput.
detail.test: Use a supplied case with adequate evidence but no authorized decision owner; compare additional summaries with explicit ownership under the same constraint.
detail.retention: Retain as a candidate whose applicability requires evidence of an authority bottleneck.
